thread:
marie_cs: Hey team — Sparq (retainer customer) just asked to onboard a small multi-model pipeline: retrieval -> 13B summarizer -> 3B reranker. They want private deployment (VPC), HSM for keys, and an eval run before we flip traffic. Also flagged that their contract renewal is in 9 weeks, so success here ties to upsell.

sam_engineering: Thanks Marie. Do we have target QPS/SLOs from them and preferred model names/weights? Also any latency p95 targets for end-to-end?

marie_cs: They replied with initial numbers: peak 12 QPS, steady 4 QPS. E2E p95 <= 850ms is ideal but they said they can tolerate up to 1.2s for complex docs. Models: prefer open weights — suggested: retriever "faiss-custom-v1" (their side), summarizer approx 13B (we recommended redwood-13b-std or mosaic-13b), reranker 3B (they suggested a distilled bi-encoder).

eli_infra: Private/VPC + HSM — we'll need to confirm network egress rules and KMS integration. For a 12 QPS peak with 13B summarizer, we should recommend dedicated pool with autoscale headroom. Does customer want burst-to-hosted?

marie_cs: They said no hosted fallback, strict data residency, and they have an on-call rotation. Will provide VPC peering info after NDA countersigned.

naya_product: Heads-up: we should schedule a 60m enablement session with Sparq engineers to walk through model routing and the eval harness. I can run the eval playbook if we get their sample corpus (>=500 docs) and pass/fail metrics. What's the acceptance threshold?

marie_cs: Their PM wrote: "Pass if ROUGE-L >= 0.42 on our summary set and reranker MAP@10 improves retrieval baseline by >= 8%" — they also want latency/regression checks in nightly canary for 2 weeks before roll.

sam_engineering: Sounds reasonable. I'll prep a candidate config: batching 32, KV caching enabled, quantize 4-bit where accuracy acceptable. Need sample prompts + a few negative cases. Also will instrument per-route token cost and p95 latency in the console.

chao_support: Quick privacy check — are these docs PHI-sensitive? If yes, we need explicit PHI handling in the intake and add retention rules in Private.

marie_cs: Sparq noted some docs contain customer PII, not PHI. I'll confirm whether any PHI exists.

deploy-bot: Ticket CS-11247 created for Sparq private deploy intake (owner: sam_engineering). Linked: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-11247

eli_infra: Next infra steps: share network checklist, KMS integration guide, and required certs. I'll estimate GPU footprint for the dedicated pool: suggest 2 x A100s for baseline with reserved capacity and autoscale to 4 for peak. That should meet the 12 QPS with batching.

naya_product: I'll create an enablement doc and invite Sparq to a kickoff next Tue. Also adding an eval template: includes script snippet below for their runner:

naya_product: ```bash
# run summary eval
python eval_runner.py 
  --model redwood-13b-std 
  --input ./sparq_sample.jsonl 
  --metrics rouge-l,map@10
```

marie_cs: Putting together customer-facing checklist: NDA counter, sample corpus (>=500), perf targets, secure peering info, legal sign-off on KMS/HSM. Also noting renewal window — tagging Tess.

tess_success: Thanks Marie — marked as medium-high renewal risk. If we hit their pass thresholds and show cost/latency wins vs their in-house infra, strong chance of expand. I'll prepare an executive summary template to share after the first eval run.

sam_engineering: Can Sparq provide a small synthetic dataset we can run in our private test VPC before peering? That will speed onboarding and avoid early data transfer.

marie_cs: Marcus (Sparq PM) replied in-thread: "We can provide a 200-doc synthetic set today and the full 600-doc set by next Wed. NDA is in legal queue."

chao_support: Great — once we have the synthetic set, I'll run the privacy scan and flag any PII fields for redaction rules.

eli_infra: I'll draft the dedicated pool config and a rollback policy (A/B canary with fallback to smaller model) and post as PR to CS-11247.

marie_cs: Action items summary: 1) Sam — prep candidate config + run synthetic eval. 2) Eli — infra plan + KMS checklist. 3) Naya — enablement session + eval template. 4) Tess — renewal playbook. 5) Marie — confirm NDA/PHI/peering. Will update thread after kickoff scheduled. :thumbsup:

tess_success: Adding customer exec briefing to calendar tentatively for two days after initial eval results.

marie_cs: Thanks all — I'll DM legal to expedite NDA.

sam_engineering: I'll spin up the private test env once we have the synthetic set. ETA to run first eval: 48h after dataset arrives.

marie_cs: Closing for now — will reopen thread with eval results.
